entries.title: A saved sign-in that did not work stops leading
entries.body: When a website turns a saved sign-in away, the task's crewmate now says so on its next card, and Infinitary remembers it on that saved sign-in. The next time a task asks you to sign in to that site, Sign in myself is the default, and Use my saved sign-in stays beside it with a note that it did not work last time. Saving the sign-in again clears the note.

picture.alt: A request to sign in to a site with Sign in myself as the default and Use my saved sign-in beside it, marked did not work last time
